messages:
mia_eng: Notice: embeddings-prod-eu started returning 502/503 intermittently at 04:12 UTC. Trace shows header-parser re-entrancy + kvcache spike. Built hotfix image v3.2.9-hf. Requesting expedited deploy with micro-canary (0.5%). Need ops + sre ok.

deploy-bot: Deploy request submitted: service=embeds-prod-eu image=v3.2.9-hf requester=mia_eng. Default canary=10%. You may request `--canary 0.5` for micro-canary. Approvals required: 2. Approve with `/approve deploy 1770009999` or react :white_check_mark:.

toni_sre: Can we get a prometheus snapshot and the last 5m flamegraphs before approving? Also prefer micro-canary 1% instead of 0.5% to ensure sampling.

harry_ops: I can do 1% and sit on pager for 45m. Post the rollback image and quick rollback steps here.

mia_eng: rollback image set to v3.2.8-stable. Rollback snippet: `deployctl rollback --service embeds-prod-eu --image v3.2.8-stable && deployctl wait --stable embeds-prod-eu` No DB changes. Prometheus snapshot: https://telemetry/internal/snaps/1770009999-predeploy (shortlink). Flamegraphs: https://telemetry/internal/flame/1770009999-predeploy.

priya_pm: Product approves expedited micro-canary. Impact: intermittent failures for batch embedding jobs - medium severity for EU customers.

toni_sre: /approve deploy 1770009999 — approving only if canary=1% and 5m observation window.

harry_ops: /approve deploy 1770009999 — approved. I'll take pager for next 60m.

deploy-bot: Approvals (2) received. Starting rollout: canary=1% -> observe 5m -> promote. Command: `deployctl rollout start --service embeds-prod-eu --image v3.2.9-hf --canary 1 --timeout 5m --requester mia_eng`

deploy-bot: Canary started. Pod: embeds-v3-2-9-hf-1 (Ready). Metrics stream: https://telemetry/internal/embeds/1770009999-canary

deploy-bot: Canary after 5m: errors=0, p99=430ms (baseline 425ms), kvcache misses down. No anomalous traces. Promoting to 100%.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Deployment SUCCESS. Release page: https://deployments.redwood/1770009999

mia_eng: thanks. I'll monitor for 1h and follow up with release note.

toni_sre: Added a transient alert: p99 increase > 30% OR error-rate > 0.3% for 45m.

harry_ops: No alerts so far. Standing by to execute rollback if needed.

priya_pm: Release note draft: "hotfix(embeds): fix header-parser loop causing cache OOM -> 503s in EU (v3.2.9-hf)". Sending to comms.

mia_eng: closing thread in 60m if stable. Great job, team :tada:
